title: Shortest Positive Window
statement:
Use a sliding window to find the shortest nonempty subarray with sum at least S.

Input
Read n S followed by n integers.

Output
Print the minimum length of a nonempty subarray with sum at least S, or 0 if none exists.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000, 1 ≤ S ≤ 10¹⁵. Each value lies in [1,10⁹].
